notes.title: Update 0.7.2
notes.content: [p]The game have been updated with the following edits:[/p][p][/p][h2]A tweak to the "Level 10" soldiers' fight[/h2][p]Since some players were getting stuck during the fight with the Level 10 soldiers, it has been made clearer that you are not supposed to fight them but instead flee the battle.[/p][p]These are the changes:[/p][list][*][p]Increased HP of Level 10 soldiers.[/p][/*][*][p]Edited the tutorial message, saying explicitly that it's virtually impossible to win the following fight.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements to the victory panel[/h2][p]Every time you win a battle, you gain EXP that you can spend in your HDev to increase your parameters. This process is manual because, scattered across the maps, you can find Food Supplements: items that provide a bonus to specific parameters. However, these can only be used when you level up, and the parameter each one boosts is a secret.[/p][p]Previously, players had to frequently check their HDev to see whether they had enough EXP to level up. Now, a new icon has been added to the victory EXP/credits panel: the [b]"UP" icon[/b], which appears once you have enough EXP to advance to the next level:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43486064/488c49d6878666c075bc1ddbc5a108627d426c92.png"][/img][/p][p]The icon’s color changes depending on whether it's the first time you've reached the required EXP or if you already had enough before. If you already had enough EXP to level up, the icon and accompanying text turn yellow, serving as a reminder to open your HDev.[/p][p]An option may be added to the menu in the future to automate advancement and ignore Supplements entirely. However, this feature will only be introduced in a future update if it aligns with how players interact with the current system.[/p]

notes.title: Here's the Release Date
notes.content:
Yeah! The game isn't dead, even if there hasn't been any news since July. Unbelievable... isn't it?

You may have to get used to it... but when there is news, it's usually not petty, like in this case, because now the game has a [b]release date[/b]. And that's not all!

[h1]The release date of the Early Access is...[/h1]
Well, it's not a secret anymore! It will be [b]Saturday, June 21st[/b], save the date! The game is basically already complete in the portion of the story that will be included in Early Access, with additional chunks of the story to be released consecutively. But since there are still various areas for improvement, I want to release a game that feels like a complete experience and will hopefully improve technically in the future, especially in terms of lighting, level design, 3D models, and so on. Of course, this Early Access period will be helpful for gathering suggestions to improve gameplay as well. We're looking forward to reading your comments, even if, unfortunately, the game doesn't have the potential to be an AAA title.

[h1]Steam Next Fest[/h1]
Barring extraordinary events, [i]Ternion[/i] will take part in the Steam Next Fest in June 2025. This means you'll be able to talk with the developer, ask questions, insult the game, and much more. And it also means you'll be able to play a demo.

[h1]A demo?[/h1]
Exactly. A demo was not planned in the beginning, but it will be released. And it will be available a few days before the game's release. It will be quite short, but it will give you an idea of what the final game will be like.

[h1]How 'bout the price?[/h1]
As I said before, it's not an AAA game and was developed by a single developer. Due to its lower technical quality, the price will be relatively low compared to most titles currently on the market. But I really hope the game itself will still be enjoyable and a memorable experience despite its indie nature. The current price, though, will slightly increase when the Early Access period is over. It won't cost $80, but there will be a slight price increase due to the additional content and as a way to reward those who believed in the project from its earliest stages.

But that's still not all!

[h1]What...?[/h1]
Yes! Because along with the game's release, a new [b]Discord[/b] server will open, allowing you to chat about the game if you feel like it. I don't know if anyone will actually want to do this, but since we use Discord a lot during development, it would be nice to make it open to external people: to interact, maybe even to create opportunities for relationships that have nothing to do with the game.

Okay, now I'm officially done! If you haven't seen the [url=https://youtu.be/wcJgJv-Mqrg]latest trailer[/url], go watch it! And... that's it. I really wish you all the best.

Cheers,
S

notes.title: Ternion’s Closed Beta: Full Main Campaign Now Available
notes.content:
[h1]An Adventure Awaits in Early Access[/h1]
Are you ready to embark on a crazy journey? “Ternion,” our highly anticipated sci-fi JRPG, has just reached a new stage of development. As the game’s Early Access launch approaches, players are in for a treat.

[h1]What Has Been Done and What’s Left?[/h1]
The part of the story that will be released with Early Access has been fully completed. This portion contains roughly 60% of the total game (with the meat of the story yet to come!), but it provides a good idea of what the completed game will be like. Even though some elements of the story are still to be discovered, you can start making assumptions by reading all the documents and investigating the lore you find around.

We still can't release the game because there's a significant number of bugs and improvements that need to be addressed before the game is released as Early Access. Notably, there's a boss that is currently a placeholder and needs to be replaced with its final version. However, those who have access to the closed beta already have access to the entirety of the Main Campaign that will be released with Early Access. If you're interested in joining this closed beta, you can visit our [url=https://mygoodyunsafeboar.altervista.org/]website[/url] and contact us (you still have the opportunity to play the game for free! Your price will be giving useful suggestions/criticism to improve it 🙏).

To have a clearer idea of what exactly will be missing in Early Access compared to the final game, take a look at our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2267630?emclan=103582791473007472&emgid=3906374309637518478]previous article[/url]!

[h1]What's the Plan for the Future?[/h1]
The plan for the future is to record a trailer to reveal the final release date for Early Access. As soon as Early Access is released, we'll continue working on the second part of the game, taking into account all of your reviews and suggestions during the process.

[h1]How Much Time Will It Take for Early Access to Become the Final Game?[/h1]
I wish I could give a precise prediction of how much time it will take, but I can't commit to a specific timeline at this moment. However, at the current trend, I would say not before [b]two years[/b] after the release of Early Access. Future updates will likely add additional content and hopefully secondary missions. I'm sorry that development will take so much time, but currently, I'm a solo developer, and it takes a lot of time to make all the cutscenes and design the levels by myself. And I'm doing this as a hobby after my full-time job, so please forgive me if the release of the final game is later than predicted!

[h1]A Final Shoutout to the Team of Project: Ternion[/h1]
I've been in contact with another team because we both wanted to call our games "Ternion," and they have been kind enough to let us keep the name "Ternion," which I've used for quite a long time for this project. They didn't ask me to do this, but I wanted to give a shoutout to them because I genuinely think they made a very fun game (I'm a fan of FPS games myself). You should definitely [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2868210/Project_Ternion/]check it out[/url]; oh, it's free.

[h1]More News Before the Release?[/h1]
Of course, yes! Or maybe no... who knows. The only sure way to know is to follow the game so you can stay up to date!

Have a nice sci-fi day, everyone!

MGUB

notes.title: Coming Soon: Early Access Release
notes.content:
Are you ready to embark on an epic adventure with the teammates of a lifetime?
Are you prepared to jump from one planet to another in a rocambolesque manhunt?
We certainly hope so because our upcoming game is set to release soon as an Early Access title.

[h1]Why an Early Access?[/h1]

As the completion of the game is still a while away, we want to provide you with a sneak peek of what the final game will entail. With an adventurous story and challenging gameplay, we aim to keep you hooked for hours on end.
[b]Unfortunately, the best and most complex parts of the plot are yet to come[/b]. However, if you enjoy the first part of the game, you're sure to love the second. To make this game a success, we need your trust!

Rest assured, your trust in us won't be misplaced! We value your suggestions during this Early Access phase, just as we did with our beta testers. We are committed to making the game the best it can be by the time of the final release.

Despite being a small team (currently composed of a single developer), the game will have some limitations but will unquestionably be a complete gaming experience. It won't be a tech demo or a buggy prototype; it will closely resemble the final game in many ways.

[h1]What will be missing?[/h1]

Compared to the final release, the Early Access version will differ in a few aspects:
[list]
[*]Voice acting will be incomplete (can be enabled in settings, but it's disabled by default).
[*]The overall look, including details and environments, may differ from the final game.
[*]Some elements of the lore might be missing in the Early Access.
[*]Some enemies/bosses might need rebalancing.
[*]The game's performance may not be as optimal, especially in certain locations (issues, especially with water and occlusion culling, still need addressing).
[*]Approximately the remaining 30/40% of the adventure.
[/list]

Given the varied scenarios depending on your relationships with different characters, we encourage you to play the game multiple times to experience the changes!

[h1]What will happen after the Early Access is released?[/h1]

The game will likely receive updates to fix bugs and add more story chunks, although the frequency won't be very high.

Another option is to release the second part of the game in one comprehensive update, with bug-fixing updates in between. We'll keep you informed of our decision.

[h1]When is that going to happen?[/h1]

[b]The exact release date will be revealed in the next trailer that will be released in the coming months[/b]. So stay tuned for more updates and don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist!

[h1]What's in store for 2024?[/h1]

Currently, we're working on the latest part of Early Access, the point where the game will pause until the next update. In the following year, a new trailer will appear with the final release date. Meanwhile, we'll focus on fixing bugs, removing placeholders, and preparing the game to be as close to the final product for the first chunk of the story, which we hope you all will appreciate.

With that said, we wish you a Happy New Year and many thrilling sci-fi adventures!

MGUB

notes.title: You didn't tell us how long will this bloody game take!
notes.content:
Welcome everyone to this first development update.
This page have been created a few months ago but no information about the release date have been provided yet.

I'll start from the beginning. This project is the videogame adaptation of a book I've personally wrote when I was 17: [url=https://www.amazon.it/Ternion-Salvatore-DErrico/dp/B084YZT3SJ]Ternion[/url] [i](luckily for you it's in Italian)[/i]. It's a project I've started in 2013 but I've never completed and I recently decided to redo from scratch. The development began at the early beginning of SARS-CoV-2 pandemic and, since then, is progressing at a quite constant rate.

The gameplay loop and most of the game fundamentals have been developed in the first four months. What I've been working on since April 2020 is setting up every scene and every cutscene of the game in chronological order. [b]28 scenes[/b] have been planned since the beginning and, currently, [b]15 of them [/b]have been completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43486064/17702417915d6a5f4619c71b967e6689189cdff8.png[/img]

So, if my proportions are correct, the game should be released in September 2025... right?
Well... there are more variables that needs to be taken into account.

[h3]Secondary missions are planned[/h3]
In addition to these 28 planned scenes there is an undefined amount of scenes for potential secondary missions or designed to explore and gather items, or fight optional bosses. At the moment no secondary mission have been developed... kind of, but the game allows and infinite amount of secondary missions that can be played at the end of the game. If you do the right choices.

[h3]Gameplay balancing and tweaking[/h3]
A few months are needed to test every single fight, to try to beat the game in every way possible to check if the game's difficulty is acceptable without a boring amount of grinding.

[h3]Beta testing and bug fixing[/h3]
An additional month or two should be dedicated to bug fixing and intense beta testing.

[h3]Voice acting[/h3]
At least half of year is needed to Voice Actors to catch up with lines for the latest parts of the game, and the lines are [b]a lot[/b]. I just hope I'm not abusing of their kindness.

[h3]So will the game be released on mid 2026?[/h3]
That's the most optimistic estimate. But...

[h3]But...?![/h3]
But level design and 3D modeling are not my greatest skills. If I managed to receive some help in that area I would definitely focus on creating cutscenes, dialogues and improving gameplay. This mean the development of these scenes would be considerably faster, and the graphics of the whole game would benefit. I really hope I can find some people willing to help me in that direction.

[h3]What about an Early Access?[/h3]
Releasing the game as an Early Access before the official release is a [i]plausible[/i] option and surely will be considered.
Please note that an Early Access:
[list]
[*]Won't have voice acting, or will have partially completed voice acting.
[*]Since the game is linear (not an open world) will interrupt at some point, until a new update is released.
[*]The levels and the graphics of the game may be subject to change after an update.
[/list]
If you wish to give your opinion related to this topic (or any other topic) you're free to leave a comment or [url=https://mygoodyunsafeboar.altervista.org/]contact us[/url].

With that said, I said everything I've planned to say. So I wish you a good day and many happy adventures. 🚀
-Sidus
